snippet.title: Cortesia Rising Trailer
snippet.description:
Cortesia Rising is a Space Captain Simulator that combines spaceship battles, ship & crew management, and turn-based tactical combat. Engage in broadside naval battles, run trading and smuggling operations, take on missions, explore planets, maintain crew morale through supplies and wages, and upgrade your ship.

     The same officers you recruit and level-up also fight alongside you in detailed tactical battles during boarding actions and planetside gunfights. The integration of these systems creates consistent progression: the crew you manage directly impacts both your success in space and your effectiveness in tactical combat.

Wishlist today on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3865960/Cortesia_Rising/

Dev Blog:
https://www.cortesiarising.com/updates
